read.en: Alphabet fell 3.1% on Oct 22 to $324.22, trading between $322.00 and $331.43. It is below the falling 5-day ($336.8), falling 10-day ($343.9), rising 30-day ($344.8), falling 100-day ($349.0) and rising 200-day ($341.3) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($356.14), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月22日下跌 3.1%，收于 $324.22，盘中区间 $322.00–331.43。股价位于下行的 5 日（$336.8）、下行的 10 日（$343.9）、上行的 30 日（$344.8）、下行的 100 日（$349.0）和上行的 200 日均线（$341.3）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$356.14），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The drop broke the $330.2–330.4 support and the $327.7 Sep 10 low, both now resistance. Resistance is $327.7–331.4, then $335.5–338.4 (Oct 1 and Oct 20 lows) and $341.3 (200-day). Support is $319.4–322 (Jan 21 low, Oct 22 low), then $314.9 (Jul 23 low) and $310.3 (Jan 2 low). A close below $319.4 would open $314.9; a close above $331.4 would target $335.5–338.4.
